summary: FASE B UOM Conversion System - Comprehensive testing completed. Backend APIs (41/41 PASS), Frontend UI for Admin/Manager/Sales roles tested. All core features working: global conversion rules, configurable tolerance, conversion calculator, RBAC, decimal comma support, trail tracking (D-07).

integration_issues.flow: PO Creation with Conversion Hint (US B-5)
integration_issues.issue: Could not locate PO creation form via search to test conversion hint display
integration_issues.note: Backend conversion API works correctly (tested). Frontend hint component exists in code. Navigation to PO form needs verification.

passed_tests: Backend: UOM Catalog (23 units, 5 dimensions, all textile units present)
Backend: UOM Rules List (18 rules, 15 active, standard physics rules present)
Backend: Rule Creation with decimal comma (100,5 → 100.5)
Backend: Rule validations (duplicate rejected, zero factor rejected, same unit rejected, cross-dimension rejected)
Backend: Rule Update with decimal comma (105,75 → 105.75)
Backend: Rule Status Toggle (activate/deactivate)
Backend: Settings CRUD (get/update with decimal comma 1,5 → 1.5)
Backend: Settings validation (warn > block rejected)
Backend: Conversion with trail (D-07) - all required fields present
Backend: Conversion decimal comma support (10,5 yard → 9.6 meter)
Backend: Unknown unit rejection with Indonesian message
Backend: Variance checking (ok/warn/block levels)
Backend: Usage tracking (20 document trails returned)
Backend: RBAC - manager/sales 403 for POST/PATCH/PUT, 200 for GET
Frontend US B-1: Admin views UOM Conversion screen (4 summary cards, tolerance card, calculator, 19 rules, 20 usage trails)
Frontend US B-2: Admin changes tolerance (1,5% / 3%), validates warn < block, saves successfully, restores default
Frontend US B-3: Admin can add rules (modal opens, form accepts bale→kg with factor 100,5)
Frontend US B-4: Calculator works (product selection, qty 12,5 with decimal comma, unit selection, preview shown)
Frontend US B-6: Manager read-only access (tolerance disabled, read-only message shown, no Add Rule button, can view calculator and rules)
Frontend US B-7: Sales role does not see Konversi Satuan menu in search or sidebar

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (6/7 user stories fully tested, 1 partially tested due to navigation issue)
